  file: /data/.runner
  capacity: 1

files.actions.Dockerfile:
FROM docker.io/gitea/runner:3.0.0@sha256:e4b1a4b99272b78f2f06ac60feefc8de176c49ab4be845960bb2956eaac1be04
USER root
RUN apk add --no-cache curl jq zip
USER 1000:1000
files.upload-artifact.sh:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
base="${GITHUB_SERVER_URL%/}/twirp/github.actions.results.api.v1.ArtifactService"
authorization="Authorization: Bearer ${ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN}"
request="$(jq -nc --arg run "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" '{workflow_run_backend_id:$run,name:"e2e-artifact",version:4}')"
upload="$(curl --fail --silent --show-error -H "$authorization" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "$request" "$base/CreateArtifact" | jq -er .signedUploadUrl)"
printf "real Gitea artifact\n" > /data/fixture.txt
zip -q -j /data/fixture.zip /data/fixture.txt
size="$(wc -c < /data/fixture.zip | tr -d " ")"
digest="$(sha256sum /data/fixture.zip | cut -d " " -f 1)"
curl --fail --silent --show-error -X PUT -H "Content-Type: application/octet-stream" --data-binary @/data/fixture.zip "$upload&comp=block"
request="$(jq -nc --arg run "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" --arg size "$size" --arg hash "sha256:$digest" '{workflow_run_backend_id:$run,name:"e2e-artifact",size:$size,hash:$hash}')"
curl --fail --silent --show-error -H "$authorization" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "$request" "$base/FinalizeArtifact"
echo "real Gitea workflow: artifact uploaded"

command: gitea-runner register --no-interactive --config /config.yaml --instance http://gitea:3000 --token "$$(cat /sandbox-auth/runner-token)" --name e2e-executor --labels sandbox:host && exec gitea-runner daemon --config /config.yaml
